source.exact_deadline_wording: ROUND 1 20 April 2026 | ROUND 2 01 June 2026 | ROUND 3 03 August 2026 | ROUND 4 04 September 2026 (January 2027 Intake); ROUND 1 22 October 2026 | ROUND 2 07 December 2026 | ROUND 3 24 February 2027 | ROUND 4 12 April 2027 (August 2027 Intake)
source.notes: This record is a COMPOSITE covering three separate INSEAD programmes (MIM, MBA and MIF), and INSEAD publishes no single deadline for it. I fetched the three official programme scholarship pages directly (insead.edu blocks plain HTTP fetches with 403, so I rendered the live pages in a browser and read the rendered DOM). Findings per programme: (1) MIM - the official MIM scholarships page states only 'To apply for a scholarship, or to be automatically considered for one, you must first start your MIM application.' and ties named scholarships to admission rounds ('Open for all candidates admitted in Rounds 1-3' for Kung Family and Qinqin and Xin Zhang; 'Open for all candidates admitted in Rounds 1-2' for L'Oréal for Youth) with NO calendar date anywhere on the page. (2) MBA - the official MBA scholarships page publishes a Financial Aid Calendar with eight distinct round deadlines across two intakes (January 2027 Intake: 20 April 2026, 01 June 2026, 03 August 2026, 04 September 2026; August 2027 Intake: 22 October 2026, 07 December 2026, 24 February 2027, 12 April 2027). (3) MIF - the official MIF financing page (/master-programmes/master-finance/financing) contains no deadline text at all. Because the record spans three programmes with different (and partly absent) deadlines, per AGENT_BRIEF section 6 this is not a CONFLICTING case - different programmes at the same institution having different deadlines is explicitly not a conflict - and it is not ROLLING either, because no source says 'rolling'. Writing any single one of these eight dates would misrepresent the other seven, so deadline_date stays null and the outcome is a truthful UNKNOWN. Note for the coordinator: four of the eight MBA dates (22 October 2026, 07 December 2026, 24 February 2027, 12 April 2027) are still in the future as of 2026-10-05, so if this record were ever split per programme the MBA August 2027 intake would be genuinely open; I did not select one on the record's behalf. Also note the record's stated official_source_url (the MBA international-funding page) is a lender/scheme directory and contains no deadline at all, so it cannot support any value for this record.

records.title: Åbo Akademi University tuition fee scholarship - early commitment offer and second-year reduction
records.deadline_display: Admitted students can claim the offer by accepting their study place and paying the tuition fee within a deadline specified in their admissions letter. Admitted students who do not accept their study place and do not pay the tuition fee within the deadline for the early commitment offer need to pay the full amount of 12000 €.

source.as_of: Page section 'Scholarships for students admitted in 2026 or later'
source.raw_extract:
Scholarships for students admitted in 2026 or later

Åbo Akademi University grants an early commitment offer for students liable to pay tuition fees and who are admitted for studies starting in the autumn of 2026 or later. The early commitment offer is a discount of 4000 €, which means that the remaining tuition fee for the first academic year is 8000 €. Admitted students can claim the offer by accepting their study place and paying the tuition fee within a deadline specified in their admissions letter. Admitted students who do not accept their study place and do not pay the tuition fee within the deadline for the early commitment offer need to pay the full amount of 12000 €.

For the second year, all admitted students are awarded a tuition fee reduction of 4000 €, leaving the remaining annual tuition fee at 8000 €. Applicants do not need to apply separately for this second year scholarship.
source.exact_deadline_wording: within a deadline specified in their admissions letter
source.notes: The official scholarship page publishes NO calendar date for this award. The deadline is explicitly individualised: it is 'a deadline specified in their admissions letter'. I deliberately did NOT write 2027-07-13. I fetched the official application-process page (https://www.abo.fi/en/study/apply/international-master-programmes/application-process/), which does publish a dated 'Admissions timeline 2027' including '13 July 3:00 pm (Helsinki time) Deadline to accept the offered study place' - but that is a generic admissions acceptance deadline, not the scholarship deadline, and the scholarship page itself says the scholarship deadline is the one specified in the admissions letter. Substituting the admissions date for the scholarship deadline is exactly the generic-admissions-deadline substitution the brief bans in section 5, so I rejected it and recorded it here for transparency. The second-year component has no application step at all ('Applicants do not need to apply separately for this second year scholarship'), so it contributes no deadline. I did not classify this ROLLING: although the absence of a public fixed date is functionally close, the source never says 'rolling' or 'no fixed deadline' - it says a real deadline exists and is communicated per admission - so UNKNOWN with precision 'unknown' is the truthful label.

source.raw_extract:
### Study grants for students experiencing difficulties

Scholarships for those experiencing particular personal, family and economic difficulties. The call for applications is usually published in September.

[Read the calls for applications and find the award you can apply for](https://bandi.unibo.it/agevolazioni/opportunita?tipobando=agevolazioni%23borse)

### Scholarships and study awards

Scholarships and awards are granted throughout the year.

source.exact_deadline_wording: The call for applications is usually published in September. / Scholarships and awards are granted throughout the year.
source.notes: This record is a PORTFOLIO record covering a large hub of distinct benefits (ER.GO regional grants, 150-hour collaboration grants, study grants for students experiencing difficulties, international mobility scholarships, fee exemptions, Unibo for Refugees, MUR-CRUI and MAECI scholarships, degree and doctoral awards, and more), each of which is a separate call with its own deadline. The official page publishes no single deadline for the record, and none of the two statements on it is an application deadline: 'The call for applications is usually published in September' describes when one specific call is PUBLISHED (not when applications close), and 'Scholarships and awards are granted throughout the year' describes when awards are GRANTED (not when applications close). I therefore did not record MONTH precision for September - that would convert a publication-timing convention into a deadline month and would apply it to a single sub-benefit while wrongly implying it governs the whole portfolio - and I did not record ROLLING, because the page never says applications are open on a rolling basis. Per AGENT_BRIEF section 6, differing deadlines across the different benefits at this one institution are not a conflict, so this is not CONFLICTING. The two quotes above are recorded verbatim so the convention is not lost, but no date is written. A truthful UNKNOWN is the correct result for a portfolio-level record; a per-benefit breakdown would require records that are not in this shard.
